meta.title: Mizan · Point of sale for neighbourhood shops
meta.description: Till, stock, customer credit and end-of-day closing in one app that keeps working without internet. Arabic, French, English. 14-day free trial.

hero.eyebrow: Point of sale for neighbourhood shops
hero.title: Your till always comes out right.
hero.subtitle: Mizan runs your till, your stock and your customers' credit on your shop's PC, even without internet. Your phone shows the day's sales wherever you are.
hero.note: No card needed · Arabic, French and English

offline.title: Keeps selling when the internet drops
offline.body: Power cuts and weak 4G shouldn't stop a sale. Mizan sells from the PC itself and catches up on its own.

sell.title: Sell on the PC
sell.body: The till works from the PC's own database. No connection needed to scan, charge or print.

sync.title: Sync when online
sync.body: Every minute, sales go up to your online store and price changes come back down.

check.title: Check from anywhere
check.body: See sales, stock and profit from your phone, or from a second till in the same shop.

features.title: Everything a small shop needs, nothing it doesn't

checkout.title: Fast checkout
checkout.body: Scan with any USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner, take cash or card, print an 80 mm receipt.

stock.title: Stock that adds up
stock.body: Every delivery, sale and return is recorded. Low-stock alerts and printable barcode labels.

credit.title: Customer credit
credit.body: Sell on account with a credit limit, take partial payments, print a customer statement.

suppliers.title: Suppliers and deliveries
suppliers.body: Receive goods, keep cost prices up to date, and track what you still owe each supplier.

cash.title: End-of-day closing
cash.body: Open the drawer with a float, close with a count, and see any difference at once.

reports.title: Profit, not just sales
reports.body: Revenue, profit, margin and best sellers, by day, category and payment method.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.body: Refund in cash or to the customer's account, with items going back into stock.

team.title: Staff accounts
team.body: Cashiers sell; only you see cost prices, reports and settings.

data.title: Your data, safe
data.body: Daily backups, one-click restore, and Excel import and export.

shops.title: Made for shops that sell over a counter
shops.languages: Each person picks their language: Arabic (right to left), French or English.

pricing.title: Two ways to pay
pricing.body: Both start with 14 free days. If a payment stops, your data stays readable: nothing is ever deleted.
pricing.payment: Pay by cash, CCP / BaridiMob or bank transfer.

cloud.name: Online subscription
cloud.desc: The web app plus every PC and phone linked to your shop.
cloud.p2: Several tills and your phone in sync

license.name: PC license
license.desc: One payment for a PC that works fully offline.
license.p4: Can be linked to the online version later

offline.a: Yes. The PC app sells, prints receipts and keeps stock without a connection. It syncs by itself when the internet comes back.

hardware.a: A Windows PC. A barcode scanner and an 80 mm receipt printer are recommended; any USB or Bluetooth scanner that types like a keyboard works.

data.q: What happens to my data if I stop paying?
data.a: Nothing is deleted. Mizan becomes read-only: you can still see everything, export it to Excel and make backups.

import.q: Can I bring my products from Excel?
import.a: Yes. Save your sheet as CSV and import products, customers and suppliers. Prices with a decimal comma are understood.

tills.q: Can I use several tills, or check from home?
tills.a: Yes. Link each PC to your online shop: every till and your phone show the same sales and stock.

languages.a: Arabic (right to left), French and English. Each user chooses their own.

payment.a: By cash, CCP / BaridiMob or bank transfer. Your subscription or license is activated as soon as the payment is recorded.

cta.title: Try Mizan free for 14 days
cta.body: Create your shop in a few minutes. No card needed.

footer.tagline: Point of sale, stock and customer credit for neighbourhood shops.
